title: Origin AI code hosting disrupts GitHub after extended outage #shorts #ai #github
description: Origin, the new AI-powered code hosting platform launched by Cursor—an AI coding tool acquired by SpaceX for $60 billion—offers a disruptive alternative to GitHub. Origin is designed to handle simultaneous interactions from multiple AI agents, addressing a key limitation of GitHub, which was built for sequential human workflows. This innovation streamlines the development process by integrating code review, pull requests, and AI-driven changes within a single interface. By enabling AI agents to autonomously read repositories, make changes, and open pull requests, Origin improves efficiency for developers managing complex, automated workflows. Its launch shortly after GitHub experienced a six-hour outage highlights the market demand for more advanced, AI-friendly coding environments. Origin represents a significant shift in code hosting infrastructure, potentially redefining how development teams and AI collaborate in software creation. #Origin #CursorAI #SpaceX #AICoding #CodeHosting #GitHubAlternative #PullRequests #SoftwareDevelopment #AIAutomation #DevTools #TechInnovation #CodingPlatforms #ArtificialIntelligence #DeveloperExperience #ProgrammingTools
